item: Claim trail source counts count outlets by domain, the key the same-source join uses, not by outlet labels (outlet list item 13, L4)
summary: A path's n_sources and sources, and the trail's n_sources, were the number of distinct outlet LABELS, while the same-source join that builds the paths keys on the outlet domain (else source_id). One outlet whose feeds carry different labels counted as several sources on a path the join had made of one voice; two outlets sharing a label counted as one. Both now read one helper (_voice), the shown names stay one per counted voice, and an article with neither key falls back to its name. Three tests pin the cases and fail on the old code.
